calls.statement:
SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS hd, status, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) nd, MIN(order_ts_utc) mn, MAX(order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE order_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-11-30 20:00:00' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-02 04:00:00'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' AND status <> 'cancelled'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id AND p.category='ZZ Test') THEN o.web_order_id END) AS test_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='processing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) processing,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stg_web_order_load s WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', s.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01') AS stg_rows,
  (SELECT MAX(order_ts_utc) FROM fact_web_order) AS max_ts
FROM o
